raw_text: Janes has obtained imagery and signals intelligence analysis suggesting that China's People's Liberation Army Navy has detected an Indian Arihant-class SSBN conducting a deterrence patrol in the Bay of Bengal. The detection was reportedly made using a combination of fixed underwater acoustic arrays deployed in the Andaman Sea and satellite-based wake detection. Concurrently, a PLAN Type 093A Shang II-class SSN was observed transiting the eastern Indian Ocean, suggesting a possible trailing operation. This development has significant implications for India's sea-based nuclear deterrent posture and the broader strategic balance in the Indo-Pacific region.
